summary: Resumed the DBN-ADAPTER lane after the predecessor's usage-limit death: reviewed all ten dbn modules against the official Databento reference implementation + docs (URLs + access dates recorded in futbt/dbn/README.md), fixed 22 predecessor defects (the code had NEVER been run: two fatal fixture KeyErrors, a never-crossing OI design, broken pack/unpack for reserved-field layouts, inverted stat_flags bit 1, off-by-one settlement session dates, vacuous monotonicity check, misapplied minute-gap scan, daily-session misclassification, CSV self-misidentification as rtype 0, UNDEF_PRICE classified CROSSED, internally inconsistent fixture truth, wrong CSV column-order model, and more), completed the remaining capability layer (cadence-aware session calendar, roll-window volume/OI crossover summary, clean settlement accounting, stype-provenance typing), created the missing dbn/__init__.py, and delivered the test + disclosure layer: 144 tests across 6 files covering every numbered capability incl. the adversarial cases (DST transition, holiday short session, two-contract roll window with volume/OI migration spanning fall-back, negative CL price, crossed/locked BBO, duplicate + gap timestamps, 6J scale, stale close-only bars, unknown record type -> typed error), plus futbt/dbn/README.md with the IMPLEMENTED/TESTED/NOT_IMPLEMENTED table and the full predecessor-corrections log. Full suite 417 tests OK (211 base + 144 dbn + 62 test_portfolio_* from concurrent lane MULTIASSET-WIRING, all green in the same run).

known_limitations: SYNTHETIC-ONLY: every test runs on futbt/dbn/fixtures.py generated data; zero claims about real GLBX.MDP3 bytes — first real batch must pass ../DATA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md (NOT_RUN)

docs.databento.com is JS-rendered and unreadable by automated fetchers; schema semantics were verified against the official reference implementation (github.com/databento/dbn main, fetched 2026-10-02) plus docs pages via search snippets — both URL lists recorded in futbt/dbn/README.md

DBN v1/v2 decode, .zst decompression, schema definitions in metadata, and record types mbo/mbp-10/status/imbalance/error/cmbp-1/cbbo are NOT_IMPLEMENTED with typed fail-closed refusals (bbo-1s/bbo-1m ARE implemented)
CSV/JSONL ingest cannot prove stype (no metadata in text exports): execution_use() returns 'unproven_stype'; the continuous-execution guard only has teeth on DBN-framed files

No offline holiday calendar exists: short sessions are INFERRED from bar coverage (HOLIDAY_SHORT + inferred_short flag), never asserted as exchange fact; session windows use standard 17:00-16:00 CT bounds
GLBX stat_flags normalization is a published vendor data-quality issue before 2015-01-20 — re-verify on first real batch
first_notice is NOT_AVAILABLE in DBN definitions: any first-notice-dependent logic stays NOT_RUN (typed raising accessor)
Live API paths and any billable metadata calls: NOT_IMPLEMENTED / NOT_RUN by round invariant (no API key)
